summary: Open gravel and dirt clearing beside Boundary Road, backing onto empty paddock.
reasons: Tyre tracks and gravel apron from road
No homes nearby, paddock and industry only

drivers.seclusion: Open paddock east, road and wetland west, one industrial shed about 150 m north-west. No dwellings mapped or seen.
drivers.access_and_room: Gravel entry off the road edge with tyre tracks; wide cleared dirt and gravel area, plenty of room.
drivers.traffic: Busy road beside it, but the van stands well off the lane.
drivers.convention: Rough informal clearing with some dumped soil and rubbish; no vans seen.

flags: Low-lying: about 4 m elevation, Oxley Creek 124 m away
Mapped gate 234 m away, not on the only access
sun_shade: Open and unshaded; full sun all day.
rubbish: Some dumped soil heaps and a small rubbish pile near the entrance.
cannot_judge: Whether the entrance is gated at night

best_section.where: Gravel clearing just east of Boundary Road, a little south of the entrance
